What makes it different

## Local and craft makers you won't find on the big networks

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around the small producers the transnational
marketplaces never list: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops, cooperatives and
family farms. Each is checked against an official government registry or a recognized origin mark,
and sorted by category and country, so you can actually find and trust them.

[Browse the catalog by category and country →][8]
* Verified at the source
  
  Matched to official business registries (SIREN, CVR, RCCM and dozens more) or protected origin
  marks like PDO, GI and Genuine Jersey, not a self-declared badge.
* Sorted by category and country
  
  Find a specific product in a specific market instead of scrolling an endless, unfiltered list.
* Reachable even without a website
  
  Small makers surfaced through public registries and social profiles, with the source of every
  listing shown so you can check it yourself.

Matching engine

## Matching that explains itself

Every distributor is scored 0 to 100 against a manufacturer's offer on seven weighted criteria, with
a plain-language rationale, not a black box.
* 22%
  
  Country coverage
  
  Share of the manufacturer's target markets the distributor actively covers.
* 20%
  
  Category match
  
  Whether the distributor specialises in the offer's product category.
* 16%
  
  Sales channels
  
  Overlap between the requested sales channels and the distributor's channels.
* 13%
  
  Minimum order fit
  
  How comfortably the distributor's order capacity meets the minimum.
* 12%
  
  Certification fit
  
  Required certifications the distributor already holds.
* 9%
  
  Existing network fit
  
  Customer types served, brand portfolio size, partner-type match, and years in distribution.
* 8%
  
  Trade-agreement fit
  
  Preferential trade arrangements between the offer's target markets and the distributor's coverage

FAQ

## Common questions

How the marketplace works for manufacturers and distributors.

Where do the companies come from, and what makes this catalog different?

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around small local and craft producers that the
big transnational marketplaces don't carry: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops,
cooperatives and family farms. Each listing is checked against an official government business
registry (SIREN in France, CVR in Denmark, RCCM, and dozens more) or a recognized origin mark like
PDO, GI or Genuine Jersey, and sorted by category and country. That is the difference, unique local
supply you can't find elsewhere, verified at the source and actually findable.

The catalog has thousands of manufacturers, are they real companies?

Yes. Listings are sourced from public trade registries, export databases and verified business
directories across 200+ markets, and every website is checked to be live before a listing goes
public. Each profile shows trust signals you can check yourself, and we plainly mark which companies
are Verified versus listed from public sources. These are real companies, not fabricated entries.

What makes this different from cold outreach or hiring a trade agent?

Three things. First, manufacturers here have published exactly what markets, channels and partner
types they want, so your introduction is expected, not ignored. Second, your distributor profile is
matched against their requirements before you even hit send, so both sides already know it's a fit.
Third, contact details stay private until both parties agree to connect, no spam, no wasted calls.

Is it really free? What's the business model?

Distributors, importers, wholesalers and sales agents use the platform completely free, browse,
build a profile, send introduction requests. Manufacturers can claim their listing and receive
requests for free too. We plan to offer optional paid features for manufacturers who want promoted
placement and advanced reach, but the core marketplace stays free for both sides.

Who can see my contact details and company information?

Your direct contact information, email, phone, address, is never shown publicly. It's only shared
with a specific counterpart after both sides agree to the introduction. Your company profile (name,
location, categories, description) is public and helps the right partners find you.

How quickly can I realistically expect a first connection?

Distributors with a complete profile and a clear target category typically hear back within a few
days of sending their first request. Manufacturers with detailed profiles and active distribution
offers usually receive their first inbound request within 2-4 weeks. Response speed depends on both
sides, we notify immediately by email so nothing sits unseen.

Can I use the platform in my own language?

Yes. The interface is available in 17 languages, use the language switcher on any page. In your
dashboard you can write your profile, offers and product descriptions in your own language and
translate them to English in one click. Catalog content is also shown machine-translated in several
major languages.

### Wide range of innovations; diverse and differentiated product portfolio

[Read More][71]

## At Hetero, our every action seeks to inspire human belief in accessibility and affordability of
## life-saving medicines across the world.

With unparalleled strengths in pharmaceutical research, manufacturing, and marketing, we are
positioned to serve people regardless of geographies. Our new identity embodies this drive to expand
our reach and capabilities in order to respond with agility to the world’s evolving health needs.
Our every action seeks to inspire human belief in accessibility and affordability of life-saving
medicines across the world.

## Partnering with MPP to expand access of nirmatrelvir & ritonavir generics for COVID-19 treatment

To ensure significant increase in access to COVID-19 treatments for all people, particularly those
living in the poorest parts of the world.

[Read More][72]

## Positive results in Phase III trials of Hetero’s Movfor (Molnupiravir)

Demonstrated that Molnupiravir along with Standard of Care (SOC) reduced the risk of hospitalization
by over 65% compared to SOC alone.

## Global Innovative Medical Device Manufacturing and Design

During our 80-year legacy of cutting-edge medical device manufacturing and medical device
development, we have established a solid patient-focused foundation in cardiac rhythm, cardio and
vascular health, neuromodulation devices, and custom medical battery packs and chargers for global
OEMs. Integer is a world leader in advanced medical device design and outsourcing across four
continents. Our technology and manufactured components can be found in almost every global medical
device brand you trust. Our commitment to manufacturing excellence ensures that your medical devices
get to market faster with uncompromising reliability and quality. Innovation is key to Integer's
growth as we continue to explore medtech's emerging markets.

[Read about our Markets][140]

## Cutting-edge Medical Device Technologies

We provide innovative, high quality medical device technologies - including catheters, guidewires,
introducers, delivery systems, tantalum capacitors, implantable ports, neuromodulation devices,
pacemaker batteries, implantable and external batteries, and much more – to meet customers’ needs
and help enhance the lives of patients worldwide. The products we design and manufacture range from
finished device systems to Class III Medical Devices and hundreds of components dispersed among more
than 15 markets. We also provide market-ready products to medical device OEMs. From product design
to completed systems, our expertise in medical device development and battery design is foundational
to the history of cardiac rhythm and cardio and vascular health.

[Learn about our Products][141]

## Customer-centric Approach

At Integer, we blend our technology, expertise and resources to collaborate with many of the world's
leading OEM medical device companies to amplify their innovation through our state-of-the art design
and contract manufacturing capabilities. As a trusted medical device manufacturing partner, we
support our customers with:
* **Unique design expertise and development solutions that strengthen and de-risk new product
  development**
* **Market-ready guidewires and introducers to deliver unique therapies**
* **Advanced medical device manufacturing to meet customers’ exact requirements and quality
  standards**
* **Cell and custom battery pack design, development and manufacturing expertise to meet our
  customers' power requirements**

Our deep expertise, flexible approach, vertically integrated supply chain and global footprint
enable us to support you every step of the way to deliver successful, high-quality medical devices
that meet and exceed expectations. And the knowledge of our quality experts goes beyond the basics
of regulatory certification and compliance to help ensure your product meets all of today’s
necessary and required standards. In short, we help our customers minimize risk and bring
high-quality medical devices to market faster.

[Learn about our Approach ][142]

## World Class Contract Manufacturing Excellence

As an established medical device manufacturer and medical device development company, we understand
your clinical, development and manufacturing challenges. Our collaborative approach starts with
assessing your unique requirements, suggesting adjustments to optimize product design and leveraging
our years of experience to realize your project goals and get your product to market faster.

We provide leading medical device companies with comprehensive product development and product
transfer processes. Our broad capabilities and expertise include:
* **Research, design and development**
* **Testing and certification expertise to meet quality and regulatory requirements**
* **Prototyping**
* **Product lifecycle management**
* **Global medical device manufacturing**
* **Vertical integration and localized operations**
* **Strategic sourcing and supply chain management**

Using our proven, unique design expertise and development processes, we meticulously manage each
step of the product lifecycle to help you deliver successful results.

[Read about our Capabilities ][143]

## High-quality Medical Device Outsource Manufacturing

Integer Holdings Corporation (NYSE: ITGR) is one of the largest medical device contract development
and manufacturing organizations (CDMOs) in the world, serving the cardio and vascular,
neuromodulation, and cardiac rhythm management markets. As a strategic partner of choice, we advance
the goals of our medical device customers through industry-leading engineering and manufacturing,
with a relentless commitment to quality, service, and innovation. The company's brands include
Greatbatch Medical® and Lake Region Medical®.

## Driven by Innovation and Expertise.
## Proven by Manufacturing Excellence and Quality.

**Strengthen your innovation **with our rapid prototyping, design and development expertise, and
clinical know-how to take you seamlessly from concept to production

**Get to market faster **by utilizing our platform technologies and market-ready products that
provide differentiated performance and portfolio expansion

**Optimize your supply chain **through our global R&D and manufacturing capabilities to consistently
achieve design requirements, quality standards, and on-time delivery

[Let’s Start a Project Together][139]

## Global Innovative Medical Device Manufacturing and Design

During our 80-year legacy of cutting-edge medical device manufacturing and medical device
development, we have established a solid patient-focused foundation in cardiac rhythm, cardio and
vascular health, neuromodulation devices, and custom medical battery packs and chargers for global
OEMs. Integer is a world leader in advanced medical device design and outsourcing across four
continents. Our technology and manufactured components can be found in almost every global medical
device brand you trust. Our commitment to manufacturing excellence ensures that your medical devices
get to market faster with uncompromising reliability and quality. Innovation is key to Integer's
growth as we continue to explore medtech's emerging markets.

[Read about our Markets][140]

## Cutting-edge Medical Device Technologies

We provide innovative, high quality medical device technologies - including catheters, guidewires,
introducers, delivery systems, tantalum capacitors, implantable ports, neuromodulation devices,
pacemaker batteries, implantable and external batteries, and much more – to meet customers’ needs
and help enhance the lives of patients worldwide. The products we design and manufacture range from
finished device systems to Class III Medical Devices and hundreds of components dispersed among more
than 15 markets. We also provide market-ready products to medical device OEMs. From product design
to completed systems, our expertise in medical device development and battery design is foundational
to the history of cardiac rhythm and cardio and vascular health.

[Learn about our Products][141]

## Customer-centric Approach

At Integer, we blend our technology, expertise and resources to collaborate with many of the world's
leading OEM medical device companies to amplify their innovation through our state-of-the art design
and contract manufacturing capabilities. As a trusted medical device manufacturing partner, we
support our customers with:
* **Unique design expertise and development solutions that strengthen and de-risk new product
  development**
* **Market-ready guidewires and introducers to deliver unique therapies**
* **Advanced medical device manufacturing to meet customers’ exact requirements and quality
  standards**
* **Cell and custom battery pack design, development and manufacturing expertise to meet our
  customers' power requirements**

Our deep expertise, flexible approach, vertically integrated supply chain and global footprint
enable us to support you every step of the way to deliver successful, high-quality medical devices
that meet and exceed expectations. And the knowledge of our quality experts goes beyond the basics
of regulatory certification and compliance to help ensure your product meets all of today’s
necessary and required standards. In short, we help our customers minimize risk and bring
high-quality medical devices to market faster.

[Learn about our Approach ][142]

## World Class Contract Manufacturing Excellence

As an established medical device manufacturer and medical device development company, we understand
your clinical, development and manufacturing challenges. Our collaborative approach starts with
assessing your unique requirements, suggesting adjustments to optimize product design and leveraging
our years of experience to realize your project goals and get your product to market faster.

We provide leading medical device companies with comprehensive product development and product
transfer processes. Our broad capabilities and expertise include:
* **Research, design and development**
* **Testing and certification expertise to meet quality and regulatory requirements**
* **Prototyping**
* **Product lifecycle management**
* **Global medical device manufacturing**
* **Vertical integration and localized operations**
* **Strategic sourcing and supply chain management**

Using our proven, unique design expertise and development processes, we meticulously manage each
step of the product lifecycle to help you deliver successful results.

[Read about our Capabilities ][143]

## High-quality Medical Device Outsource Manufacturing

Integer Holdings Corporation (NYSE: ITGR) is one of the largest medical device contract development
and manufacturing organizations (CDMOs) in the world, serving the cardio and vascular,
neuromodulation, and cardiac rhythm management markets. As a strategic partner of choice, we advance
the goals of our medical device customers through industry-leading engineering and manufacturing,
with a relentless commitment to quality, service, and innovation. The company's brands include
Greatbatch Medical® and Lake Region Medical®.

# Le Laboratoire spécialisé dans la fabrication de solutions injectables

Depuis plus de 130 ans, les Laboratoires CDM Lavoisier, entreprise pharmaceutique française
indépendante, sont spécialisés dans la mise au point, la fabrication et la distribution de produits
injectables stériles répondant aux dernières réglementations internationales. Nous commercialisons
des médicaments injectables en ampoules, flacons et poches, et des dispositifs médicaux destinés aux
pharmacies d’officines, ainsi qu’aux hôpitaux publics et privés. Au sein de notre site industriel de
La Chaussée Saint Victor, nous fabriquons nos propres produits mais également ceux d’autres acteurs
du secteur.

[Savoir-faire]

## Fabrication et distribution de médicaments sous AMM Lavoisier

CDM Lavoisier dispose d’un portfolio de médicaments injectables couvrant différentes aires
thérapeutiques (nutrition, anesthésie réanimation, traitement de la douleur, etc…). Ces médicaments
sont fabriqués sur notre site de La Chaussée Saint Victor.

[Nos Médicaments][34]
[Façonnage]

## Fabrication de médicaments pour le compte de laboratoires pharmaceutiques et donneurs d’ordre
## publics

Fort de son savoir-faire de plus d’un siècle dans la fabrication de médicaments injectables, CDM
Lavoisier développe et produit de nombreuses solutions injectables pour le compte de tiers dans le
cadre de son activité de façonnage pharmaceutique.

[Façonnage pharmaceutique][35]

# Le Laboratoire spécialisé dans la fabrication de solutions injectables

Depuis plus de 130 ans, les Laboratoires CDM Lavoisier, entreprise pharmaceutique française
indépendante, sont spécialisés dans la mise au point, la fabrication et la distribution de produits
injectables stériles répondant aux dernières réglementations internationales. Nous commercialisons
des médicaments injectables en ampoules, flacons et poches, et des dispositifs médicaux destinés aux
pharmacies d’officines, ainsi qu’aux hôpitaux publics et privés. Au sein de notre site industriel de
La Chaussée Saint Victor, nous fabriquons nos propres produits mais également ceux d’autres acteurs
du secteur.

PowerShocker LGT-2500X Vet is a compressed pneumatic ballistic shockwave therapy device, bringing
the most advanced way to treat musculoskeletal disorders in animals with quality, speed, and ease.
With premium features and a sleek design, it is a premier solution for veterinary clinics to
streamline workflow, increase efficiency, and improve animal care.

[Veterinary Extracorporeal Shockwave Therapy Device PowerShocker LGT-2500X Vet][117]
[The LGT-2660 Series Electromagnetic Stimulator]
Electromagnetic Stimulator for Musculoskeletal Rehabilitation LGT-2660AP/BP

The LGT-2660 Series Electromagnetic Stimulator for Musculoskeletal Pain is an advanced
rehabilitation device engineered to address a wide range of musculoskeletal pain conditions and
associated dysfunctions. Operating on the principle of electromagnetic induction, it generates
induced currents to regulate neuromuscular function while delivering deeply penetrating energy—this
energy transcends superficial tissues to act directly on muscles, joints, and bones. For both acute
and chronic musculoskeletal pain, it provides a safe, efficient, and medication-free new solution.

[Electromagnetic Stimulator for Musculoskeletal Rehabilitation LGT-2660AP/BP][118]
[Electromagnetic Stimulator for Body Shaping]
Electromagnetic Stimulator for Body Shaping LGT-2650BP

The LGT-2650BP is a premium unisex body contouring device. Powered by high-intensity magnetic
stimulation, it induces intense muscle contractions—effectively boosting muscle tone while reducing
stubborn fat deposits. It is widely suited for weight management, body shaping, and individuals with
excess weight alike.

[Electromagnetic Stimulator for Body Shaping LGT-2650BP][119]
[Electromagnetic Stimulator LGT-2640AP for Pelvic floor rehabilitation]
Electromagnetic Stimulator for Pelvic floor rehabilitation LGT-2640AP

The LGT-2640AP Pelvic Floor Magnetic Stimulator is a precision rehabilitation device designed for
targeted pelvic floor therapy. Featuring 24 visualized preset protocols (paired with anatomical
diagrams), customizable treatment plans, and a pre-adaptation function, it delivers non-invasive,
painless stimulation to support postpartum recovery, male pelvic floor rehabilitation, and geriatric
pelvic health. 

[Electromagnetic Stimulator for Pelvic floor rehabilitation LGT-2640AP][120]
[High-Frequency Therapy Device LGT-3500GP]
High-Frequency Therapy Device LGT-3500GP（Desktop Design）

LGT-3500GP fits tight spaces without sacrificing performance. Equipped with full TECAR tech, dual
tissue-targeting modes, and core safety features, it handles post-op rehab, shallow tissue care, and
more—lightweight, durable, and perfect for space-conscious facilities.

[High-Frequency Therapy Device LGT-3500GP（Desktop Design）][121]
[High Frequency Therapy 3500LP]
High Frequency Therapy Device LGT-3500LP(Upright Design)

 The LGT-3500LP has an upright design with plenty of storage and rolling casters for easy mobility.
It uses TECAR Therapy, and it has dual CET/RET modes, 300 KHz~1 MHz frequencies, and safety features
like real-time temperature monitoring. This gives you precise, efficient treatments for deep tissue
repair and pain relief.

[High Frequency Therapy Device LGT-3500LP(Upright Design)][122]

Rehab Bike for Upper and Lower Limbs, Active-Passive Trainer (APT) RehaMoto LGT-5100D Config II

The RehaMoto LGT-5100D Config II is a rehabilitative training device designed to facilitate both
active and passive movements of a person's lower and upper limbs. This device features four training
modes: active-passive training, assistive training, symmetry training, and isokinetic training.
Additionally, it is equipped with multiple protection functions, including spasm control, emergency
stop, max. speed control, and speed setting prompt.

[Rehab Bike for Upper and Lower Limbs, Active-Passive Trainer (APT) RehaMoto LGT-5100D Config
II][123]

RehaMoto LGT-5100D Config I. The intelligent identification device realizes real - time monitoring
of user training status and smooth conversion between different modes. Fully realize the best

Combination Therapy Machine Ultrasound and Electrotherapy Device LGT-2900EUV

The LGT-2900EUV Ultrasound Electrotherapy Machine is a remarkable all-in-one device that integrates

Effective Gradient Compression DVT Pump LGT-2200DVT

More Products
][116]

Longest medical works to provide high-quality, cost-effective, and durable physiotherapy equipment,
aesthetic equipment, and rehabilitation devices that are extensively used in sports physiotherapy,
neurological rehabilitation, orthopedics, post-surgical recovery, musculoskeletal physiotherapy,
pain management, and aesthetic medicine.

[28th Madrid World Congress ISMST]
[FDA Approves Longest LGT-2320 Low-Frequency NMES/TENS Devices]
[Longest Medical KEY-products 2026]
[Precision Cold,Optimal Pain Relief]
[Advanced ESWT Device,Enhanced Musculoskeletal Health]
[3 in 1 Combo,Expanded Treatment Capability]
[professional shockwave therapy machine LGT-2500X (1)]
Veterinary Extracorporeal Shockwave Therapy Device PowerShocker LGT-2500X Vet

PowerShocker LGT-2500X Vet is a compressed pneumatic ballistic shockwave therapy device, bringing
the most advanced way to treat musculoskeletal disorders in animals with quality, speed, and ease.
With premium features and a sleek design, it is a premier solution for veterinary clinics to
streamline workflow, increase efficiency, and improve animal care.

[Veterinary Extracorporeal Shockwave Therapy Device PowerShocker LGT-2500X Vet][117]
[The LGT-2660 Series Electromagnetic Stimulator]
Electromagnetic Stimulator for Musculoskeletal Rehabilitation LGT-2660AP/BP

The LGT-2660 Series Electromagnetic Stimulator for Musculoskeletal Pain is an advanced
rehabilitation device engineered to address a wide range of musculoskeletal pain conditions and
associated dysfunctions. Operating on the principle of electromagnetic induction, it generates
induced currents to regulate neuromuscular function while delivering deeply penetrating energy—this
energy transcends superficial tissues to act directly on muscles, joints, and bones. For both acute
and chronic musculoskeletal pain, it provides a safe, efficient, and medication-free new solution.

[Electromagnetic Stimulator for Musculoskeletal Rehabilitation LGT-2660AP/BP][118]
[Electromagnetic Stimulator for Body Shaping]
Electromagnetic Stimulator for Body Shaping LGT-2650BP

The LGT-2650BP is a premium unisex body contouring device. Powered by high-intensity magnetic
stimulation, it induces intense muscle contractions—effectively boosting muscle tone while reducing
stubborn fat deposits. It is widely suited for weight management, body shaping, and individuals with
excess weight alike.

[Electromagnetic Stimulator for Body Shaping LGT-2650BP][119]
[Electromagnetic Stimulator LGT-2640AP for Pelvic floor rehabilitation]
Electromagnetic Stimulator for Pelvic floor rehabilitation LGT-2640AP

The LGT-2640AP Pelvic Floor Magnetic Stimulator is a precision rehabilitation device designed for
targeted pelvic floor therapy. Featuring 24 visualized preset protocols (paired with anatomical
diagrams), customizable treatment plans, and a pre-adaptation function, it delivers non-invasive,
painless stimulation to support postpartum recovery, male pelvic floor rehabilitation, and geriatric
pelvic health. 

[Electromagnetic Stimulator for Pelvic floor rehabilitation LGT-2640AP][120]
[High-Frequency Therapy Device LGT-3500GP]
High-Frequency Therapy Device LGT-3500GP（Desktop Design）

LGT-3500GP fits tight spaces without sacrificing performance. Equipped with full TECAR tech, dual
tissue-targeting modes, and core safety features, it handles post-op rehab, shallow tissue care, and
more—lightweight, durable, and perfect for space-conscious facilities.

[High-Frequency Therapy Device LGT-3500GP（Desktop Design）][121]
[High Frequency Therapy 3500LP]
High Frequency Therapy Device LGT-3500LP(Upright Design)

 The LGT-3500LP has an upright design with plenty of storage and rolling casters for easy mobility.
It uses TECAR Therapy, and it has dual CET/RET modes, 300 KHz~1 MHz frequencies, and safety features
like real-time temperature monitoring. This gives you precise, efficient treatments for deep tissue
repair and pain relief.

[High Frequency Therapy Device LGT-3500LP(Upright Design)][122]
[rehab-bike-for-upper-and-lower-limbs-rehamoto-lgt-5100d 2]
Rehab Bike for Upper and Lower Limbs, Active-Passive Trainer (APT) RehaMoto LGT-5100D Config II

The RehaMoto LGT-5100D Config II is a rehabilitative training device designed to facilitate both
active and passive movements of a person's lower and upper limbs. This device features four training
modes: active-passive training, assistive training, symmetry training, and isokinetic training.
Additionally, it is equipped with multiple protection functions, including spasm control, emergency
stop, max. speed control, and speed setting prompt.

[Rehab Bike for Upper and Lower Limbs, Active-Passive Trainer (APT) RehaMoto LGT-5100D Config
II][123]
[rehab-bike-for-upper-and-lower-limbs-rehamoto-lgt-5100D]
Rehab Bike for Upper and Lower Limbs, Active-Passive Trainer (APT) RehaMoto LGT-5100D

RehaMoto controls the servo motor through the central processing unit and the biomechanical
monitoring feedback system. Users can do passive, assisted, active, and constant-speed training by
RehaMoto LGT-5100D Config I. The intelligent identification device realizes real - time monitoring
of user training status and smooth conversion between different modes. Fully realize the best
clinical training effect, and promote the recovery of users' motor function.

[Rehab Bike for Upper and Lower Limbs, Active-Passive Trainer (APT) RehaMoto LGT-5100D][124]
[Air Compression Therapy Device]
IPC Pump Lymphatic Drainage Massage Device LGT-2210DS

The LGT-2210DS is a cutting-edge IPC pump and air compression therapy device, designed to elevate
service standards in physiotherapy, rehabilitation, and cosmetology clinics. It delivers seamless,
comfortable gradient and sequential pneumatic compressions to effectively enhance blood and lymph
flow. Supporting 4-chamber/6-chamber leg/arm cuffs and 24-chamber full-body cuffs, it offers
versatile, precise treatment for diverse needs.

[IPC Pump Lymphatic Drainage Massage Device LGT-2210DS][125]
[Combination Therapy Machine Ultrasound and Electrotherapy Device LGT-2900EUV]
Combination Therapy Machine Ultrasound and Electrotherapy Device LGT-2900EUV

The LGT-2900EUV Ultrasound Electrotherapy Machine is a remarkable all-in-one device that integrates
ultrasound, electrotherapy, and vacuum therapy. With its modular design, it offers up to three
different modules in a single compact unit, enabling independent or combined treatments of multiple
modalities in one device. This design not only improves efficiency and reduces costs but also
enhances the effects of pain relief, tissue repair, and muscle function recovery through synergistic
effects.

[Combination Therapy Machine Ultrasound and Electrotherapy Device LGT-2900EUV][126]
[lgt-2200dvt]
Effective Gradient Compression DVT Pump LGT-2200DVT

The LGT-2200DVT is a compression therapy device comprised of an intermittent pneumatic controller
(main unit), sleeves, and a connection hose. Its working principle is that air inflates and deflates
the sleeves sequentially to generate circulating pressure on the human body. By squeezing the
proximal and distal limbs, it can directly or indirectly promote blood circulation and the lymphatic
system, improve body micro-circulation, prevent thrombi, and reduce limb swelling. It addresses
diseases related to blood and lymph circulation. It is widely used in hospital settings to improve
workflow efficiency and enhance patient care. 

[Effective Gradient Compression DVT Pump LGT-2200DVT][127]
[LGT-2201DVT]
Deep Vein Thrombosis (DVT) Compression Therapy Device LGT-2201DVT

The LGT-2201DVT is a compression therapy device. It is composed of an intermittent pneumatic
controller (main unit), sleeves, and a connection hose. The working principle is that air inflates
and deflates the sleeves sequentially to generate circulating pressure on the human body.

By squeezing the proximal and distal limbs, it can directly or indirectly promote blood circulation
and the lymphatic system, improve the body's micro-circulation, prevent thrombi, reduce limb
swelling, and address diseases related to blood and lymph circulation. Suitable places for use are
clinics and hospitals.

[Compression Therapy Device LGT-2202DVT]
LGT - 2202DVT DVT Pump for Hospitals

The LGT-2202DVT is a gradient-pressure compression therapy system engineered to lower the risk of

## [Testimonials][88]
* Hematology and Transfusion International Journal has an efficient reviewing process and proofs are
  generated of very good quality facilitating timely publications.
  
  Denise E Jackson, Australia
  
  I highly recommend Advances in Ophthalmology & Visual System. This quality peer-reviewed online
  journal is staffed with industry leaders in ophthalmology that are knowledgeable and skilled in
  representing what is current in the eye care field.
  
  Jason Schmit, USA
  
  Advances in Plants & Agriculture research is a dynamic journal with cutting edge scientific
  information. They offer an excellent service and opportunity to show novel high quality research
  issues from many different countries.
  
  Marcelo Huarte, Argentina
  
  First and Foremost, the Ebook cover looks very good in Complementary and Alternative Medicine.
  
  Robelyn Garcia, USA
  
  Complementary and Alternative Medicine guys have done a great job getting this book out as a
  galley proof.
  
  David Harshfield , USA
  
  As for the e-book, the formatting you performed is very nice.
  
  Sanjive Qazi, USA
  
  I am very happy with your International Robotics & Automation Journal. The quality and speed of
  publication are great.
  
  Peter Lohmander, Sweden
  
  Congratulations to our journal for obtaining a good index in the well known repositories! I really
  appreciate the hard work you are doing for our journal to make it so successful know. I cannot
  believe International Journal of Avian & Wildlife Biology will grow so fast without your effort.
  
  Qi Chen, USA
  
  I always admire the wonderful job that you have done for the Advances in Plants & Agriculture
  Research Journal. Your enthusiasm and endless energy putting on this journal is remarkable and
  greatly appreciated.
  
  Mohammad Pessarakli, USA
  
  My overall evaluation about the work, quality and service of Journal of Analytical &
  Pharmaceutical Research, is excellent. The mechanism of the manuscript handling is really fast
  with immediate decision and the staff is always kind and readily available to help.
  
  Marcellin Ndoe Guiaro, Cameroon
  
  International Journal of Vaccines & Vaccination is great about work, quality, service and
  following up.
  
  Mohammad Salehi, Iran
  
  "MOJ Immunology enhances access to medicine for those in developing countries by publishing
  immunology information on line where anyone can digest it!"
  
  Jim Mulry, USA
  
  MOJCE has a great potential to compete with others and the service of the staff is very good for
  authors.
  
  Ahmed A Ibrahim, USA
  
  Your had been making a fantastic work in the several publications, the time in send us the
  different comments of the reviewers is fantastic, really, is a excellent work.
  
  Norma Rangel Vazquez, Mexico
  
  The MOJ Proteomics and Bioinformatics is becoming a reputed Bioinformatics Journal. The turnaround
  is fast and the Editorial assistants are friendly and professional. I am looking forward to seeing
  the published articlespublished articles in MOJPB cited in PubMed in the future
  
  Ramaswamy Narayanan, USA
  
  As a cosmetic & reconstructive gynecologist, I always read the Obstetrics & Gynecology
  International Journal to keep up with the latest updates in our specialty. I have found its depth
  and scope invaluable in supporting my work and research
  
  Amr Seifeldin , Egypt
  
  I have collaborated with AOVS over the last 2 years. Their professional and courteous approach
  made the whole process simple and enjoyable. I am very proud to have my work published in this
  journal.
  
  Alastair Stuart, London
  
  I checked for the book in your MedCrave site and I am very glad with the result. The text is very
  well presented. Thanks again and keep up the excellent work.
  
  Hisham Gad , France
  
  Hematology & Transfusion International Journal is doing an excellent job with publishing excellent
  research articles in hematology and oncology. Also it is good about the organization, is efficient
  and timely publishing
  
  Mohammad Muhsin Chisti, USA
  
  You will find in this journal valuable and original articles to keep pace with current research in
  Nutritional Health & Food Engineering.
  
  George Grant, Canada
  
  You are always cordial and willing to help researchers in presenting their scientific
  contributions with ease and accuracy.
  
  Wael Noseir, Egypt

# Leading animal welfare and veterinary care

## in Massachusetts and beyond since 1868

[ Double Your Gift ][69]

## Our Purpose

The mission of the MSPCA-Angell is to protect animals, relieve their suffering, advance their health
and welfare, prevent cruelty, and work for a just and compassionate society.

[ Learn More ][70]

## On Any Given Day

The MSPCA-Angell is saving the lives of sick and injured animals at Angell Animal Medical Center,
placing shelter pets in loving adoptive homes, investigating animal cruelty and fighting for
stronger animal protection laws and policy.

## Job Openings

The MSPCA-Angell believes that the lives of all creatures–human and non-human–are inextricably
intertwined. We believe that our shared commitment to our organizational values of Compassion,
Collaboration, Integrity, Service, Positivity, and Excellence contribute to a compassionate and just
society in which all people and animals are treated with care and respect.

Join the MSPCA-Angell team and turn your love for animals into work that matters. We offer strong
benefits, paid time off, mental health support, tuition help, retirement matching, pet care
discounts, and room to keep learning. If you’re looking for work that feels rewarding, challenging,
deeply human, and always animal-focused, you’ll find it here, apply today!

[ View All ][112]

We strive to offer the best specialized veterinary
care while providing the one-on-one compassion and customer service your clients and patients
deserve. Angell’s staff is committed to working with you to ensure the best overall health of your
patient.

In May 2022, [Sekhmet Pharmaventures][48] acquired a majority stake in Optimus Drugs Group of

Sekhmet Pharmaventures Pvt. Ltd. (part of Gamot API Pte Ltd. based in Singapore) was formed by Asian

## Frequently asked questions

What does Optimus do?
Optimus is a leading Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO), delivering
comprehensive, end-to-end solutions from clinical development to commercial manufacturing of Key
Starting Materials(KSMs), Regulatory Starting Materials(RSMs), Advanced Intermediates, Drug
Substances and Drug Products to the global innovative biotech and pharmaceutical companies.
In which areas does Optimus specialise?

Optimus specialises in:
* Exclusive development and manufacturing of Late phase Molecules.
* Custom Manufacturing of KSM’s, RSMs and Advanced Intermediates.
* Backward integration of KSM’s / Intermediates
* Development and Manufacturing of Oral Solids / Semi Solids dosage forms

How does Optimus ensure quality and compliance?
Quality is maintained through stringent standards in R&D and manufacturing, supported by strong
regulatory understanding, IP management, and robust process development, validation, and
tech-transfer capabilities.
What is the scale of manufacturing capacity?
Optimus provides flexible manufacturing capacity from gram-scale to multi-tonne production,
supporting efficient and cost-effective scale-up of complex molecules and niche molecules.
Does Optimus support custom API or formulation development?
Yes. With a team of 150+ scientists and advanced facilities, Optimus offers custom process
development, analytical method validation, tech transfer, and commercial scale-up for both drug
substances and drug products.
What are the advantages of partnering with Optimus?
* 20+ years of industry expertise
* Integrated backward manufacturing offering cost advantage
* High-quality R&D for complex and niche molecules
* Global export capability and regulatory readiness
* Focus on innovation, affordability, and excellence
Can Optimus support technology transfer or process validation?
Yes. Our expertise team has extensive experience in both technology transfer from a third party
manufacturing site as well as process validations under strict quality and regulatory frameworks.
How does Optimus handle regulatory compliance and documentation?
All submissions are supported with complete documentation such as ANDA / DMFs / IMPD , technical
packages, validation reports, and CMC data to facilitate multi-market regulatory filings.
Does Optimus offer finished formulations or only APIs?
Optimus offers both drug substance and drug products developed through its dedicated formulation R&D
and manufacturing units.

## Frequently asked questions

What does Optimus do?
Optimus is a leading Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO), delivering
comprehensive, end-to-end solutions from clinical development to commercial manufacturing of Key
Starting Materials(KSMs), Regulatory Starting Materials(RSMs), Advanced Intermediates, Drug
Substances and Drug Products to the global innovative biotech and pharmaceutical companies.
In which areas does Optimus specialise?

Optimus specialises in:
* Exclusive development and manufacturing of Late phase Molecules.
* Custom Manufacturing of KSM’s, RSMs and Advanced Intermediates.
* Backward integration of KSM’s / Intermediates
* Development and Manufacturing of Oral Solids / Semi Solids dosage forms

How does Optimus ensure quality and compliance?
Quality is maintained through stringent standards in R&D and manufacturing, supported by strong
regulatory understanding, IP management, and robust process development, validation, and
tech-transfer capabilities.
What is the scale of manufacturing capacity?
Optimus provides flexible manufacturing capacity from gram-scale to multi-tonne production,
supporting efficient and cost-effective scale-up of complex molecules and niche molecules.
Does Optimus support custom API or formulation development?
Yes. With a team of 150+ scientists and advanced facilities, Optimus offers custom process
development, analytical method validation, tech transfer, and commercial scale-up for both drug
substances and drug products.
What are the advantages of partnering with Optimus?
* 20+ years of industry expertise
* Integrated backward manufacturing offering cost advantage
* High-quality R&D for complex and niche molecules
* Global export capability and regulatory readiness
* Focus on innovation, affordability, and excellence
Can Optimus support technology transfer or process validation?
Yes. Our expertise team has extensive experience in both technology transfer from a third party
manufacturing site as well as process validations under strict quality and regulatory frameworks.
How does Optimus handle regulatory compliance and documentation?
All submissions are supported with complete documentation such as ANDA / DMFs / IMPD , technical
packages, validation reports, and CMC data to facilitate multi-market regulatory filings.
Does Optimus offer finished formulations or only APIs?
Optimus offers both drug substance and drug products developed through its dedicated formulation R&D
and manufacturing units.

Technologie

## BFS-Technologie & bottelpack-Abfüllanlagen

Die [**BFS-Technologie**][39] ermöglicht die Herstellung, Befüllung und Versiegelung von
bruchsicheren Polymerbehältern in einem nahtlosen, vollautomatischen aseptischen Prozess bei
gleichzeitig unübertroffener Flexibilität im Behälterdesign.

[**bottelpack-Anlagen**][40] können bis zu 37.500 BFS-Behälter pro Stunde produzieren. Darüber
hinaus sind sie die platzsparendsten [aseptischen Abfüllanlagen][41] auf dem Markt, optimieren
wertvollen Platz im Reinraum und gehören damit zu den effizientesten auf dem Markt.

# Leading Global Pharmaceutical Company

Salvavidas Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is committed to being the world’s leading manufacturer and
exporter of finished dosage forms (FDFs) and active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs). Our main goal
is to improve patient outcomes while establishing industry-defining standards. We strive to produce
necessary drugs that are affordable, easily available, and effective.

## We are offering
## best Services & Products

High-quality pharmaceutical, ayurvedic, and antibiotic medications are available from Salvavidas
Pharmaceutical, a well-known pharmaceutical manufacturer and supplier in India. Customers can choose
from a variety of packaging solutions for their items, and flexible payment alternatives. They
guarantee on-time delivery and keep their prices competitive. Salvavidas Pharmaceutical puts the
needs of its patients first by improving safety, efficacy, convenience, and compliance while
offering reasonably priced goods that benefit both patients and society as a whole.

throughout its development, manufacturing, sale, distribution, etc. We are dedicated to establishing
and preserving solid bonds with our clients worldwide. As a result, we are now recognized as a
reliable exporter offering service globally.

Salvavidas Pharma is a well-known Indian pharmaceutical exporter that provides a wide variety of

developed to fulfill the requirements of its customers, such as antimalarials, analgesics, and
antibiotics. Salvavidas Pharma, which has a large worldwide presence, focuses on public health as a
driver for social and economic advancement. It is currently one of the leading pharmaceutical firms
in India.

## Excellence in Manufacturing

Translumina operates three state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities located in Hechingen, Germany;
Helmond, Netherlands; and Dehradun, India. These advanced facilities are dedicated to ensuring
reliability and quality in the cardiovascular devices and systems we deliver to our global clients.

and adhere to rigorous standards, including ISO 13485:2016. This focus on quality and innovation
positions us among the best stent companies for healthcare providers worldwide.

## Discover More

Our Relentless Pursuit of Healing

[A black woman, smiling at a desk that has flowers and a pride flag displayed on it.]
Awards and Recognitions

### [ Our New Recognition as a Healthcare Equality Leader ][154]

UMass Memorial earns recognition as an LGBTQ+ Healthcare Equality Leader, demonstrating its
commitment to inclusive, high-quality care for all.

[ Learn More about Our New Recognition as a Healthcare Equality Leader ][155]
[A little girl high-fives the doctor in Urgent Care having had her ankle bandaged and a bad scrape
treated.]
Services-Treatments

### [ Urgent Care When You Need It - Seven Days a Week ][156]

Summer happens — bites, burns, scrapes and all. Get expert care fast at a convenient UMass Memorial
Health urgent care location. On-site X-ray and labs are available.

 

[ Learn More about Urgent Care When You Need It - Seven Days a Week ][157]
[A woman waves hello to a group of people in an online meeting.]
7.20.26 | Support Groups

### [ Virtual Patient and Family Cancer Support Group ][158]

Join us on Monday, July 20, with special guest Carisa Lozoraitis, Cancer Quality Program Manager at
the Medical Center. We will have an open discussion, share information, and exchange experiences.

[ Learn More about Virtual Patient and Family Cancer Support Group ][159]
[A CRNA in an operating room, smiling and looking at the camera.]
Careers

### [ We’re Hiring CRNAs ][160]

Join our team of outstanding CRNAs. We’ll offer you a strong and supportive culture, flexible
schedules, career growth opportunities and great benefits.

[ Learn More about We’re Hiring CRNAs ][161]

## Our System of Care

UMass Memorial Health is the health and wellness partner of the people of Central Massachusetts and
beyond. Our health system is made up of five hospitals, including a children’s medical center,
behavioral health services and a dedicated provider group.

# Stent manufacturers in India

Vascular Concepts (originally known as Medical Concepts Ltd.) started in 1988 with a noble mission
that continues to be our driving principal. To provide cutting edge medical devices for the
treatment of arterial diseases that are affordable for the common man. Keeping this mission in view,
the first stent implantation took place in Sion Hospital, Mumbai, where the stent was offered free
of cost to a poor cobbler. From then on there has been no looking back for us.

From this humble beginning, Vascular Concepts has now grown into a 150 Cr company with an array of
products,that is making a critical difference to the health of people across the world. We
diligently design, develop, manufacture and market endovascular medical devices that aid less
invasive therapy.

[Read more][22]

## Corporate Social Responsibility

### Heart Insure

This unique and caring endeavor from Vascular Concepts gives our patients an exclusive health care
program with a personal touch. Our team began with this novel concept in 2009. More than 20,000
patients across various hospitals in India have been enrolled in our wellness program so far.

In this program a post angioplasty patient, implanted with our Pronova XR stent, gets health
monitoring and disease management for a period of ONE YEAR. The patient is guided on how he can
identify and reduce his Cardio Vascular Disease symptoms and further risk factors. Right from the
day that the patient undergoes angioplasty, a dedicated team is actively involved in maintaining
patient records.

[
][25]

## Excellence

Vascular Concepts Limited is committed to achieving complete customer satisfaction through
processing and supplying of Cardiovascular and Endovascular implants and devices that meet all
regulatory compliance and patient requirements.We achieve this by orienting the organization and its
employees towards continual improvement in quality of systems , processes and products .

Excellence has always been at the core of what we do. This reflects in the awards that we have won
and which we continuously aspire to, in order to be a global name in our product categories.

# Stent manufacturers in India

Vascular Concepts (originally known as Medical Concepts Ltd.) started in 1988 with a noble mission
that continues to be our driving principal. To provide cutting edge medical devices for the
treatment of arterial diseases that are affordable for the common man. Keeping this mission in view,
the first stent implantation took place in Sion Hospital, Mumbai, where the stent was offered free
of cost to a poor cobbler. From then on there has been no looking back for us.

From this humble beginning, Vascular Concepts has now grown into a 150 Cr company with an array of
products,that is making a critical difference to the health of people across the world. We
diligently design, develop, manufacture and market endovascular medical devices that aid less
invasive therapy.

## Corporate Social Responsibility

### Heart Insure

This unique and caring endeavor from Vascular Concepts gives our patients an exclusive health care
program with a personal touch. Our team began with this novel concept in 2009. More than 20,000
patients across various hospitals in India have been enrolled in our wellness program so far.

In this program a post angioplasty patient, implanted with our Pronova XR stent, gets health
monitoring and disease management for a period of ONE YEAR. The patient is guided on how he can
identify and reduce his Cardio Vascular Disease symptoms and further risk factors. Right from the
day that the patient undergoes angioplasty, a dedicated team is actively involved in maintaining
patient records.

employees towards continual improvement in quality of systems , processes and products .

Excellence has always been at the core of what we do. This reflects in the awards that we have won

[About us][13]
[Innovation Excellence]

## Driven by a passion for innovation, making a difference in the world of health and care

[Innovation Excellence][14]
[Zydus Srishti]

# Living our mission of creating healthier, happier communities globally

[Zydus Srishti][15]

## Over 29000 people impacting lives across the world

Zydus group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India, and ranks 4th in the Indian pharmaceutical
industry. The group has manufacturing sites and research facilities spread across five states of
Gujarat, Maharashtra, Goa, Himachal Pradesh and Sikkim in India and in the US and Brazil.

Zydus’ global business has a strong presence in the regulated markets of the US, Europe (France and
Spain) and in the high profile markets of Latin America and South Africa. It is also present in a
big way in 25 other emerging markets worldwide.

## Where Innovation Shapes Healthcare Solutions

**Zydus’ Innovation programme** is spearheaded by **1500 researchers** across 19 sites, working on
differentiated medicines for the future.
From NCEs to vaccines, biosimilars and niche technologies, the group is exploring
different ideas and concepts, innovating constantly.

## Major Areas of Research

[NCE Research] **NCE Research**
* Cardio-Metabolic
* Inflammation and Immunology,
* Neurosciences, Oncology, Rare Diseases
[Biologics] **Biologics**
* Biosimilar Therapeutic proteins
* Biosimilar Monoclonal antibodies
* Biobetters and Novel biologics
[Vaccines] **Vaccines**
* Infectious diseases
[View More][20]

## Innovation that bridges unmet healthcare needs.

[[Tablets]][21]
[

#### Twinrab^{TM} : A Breakthrough innovation in rabies PEP

World’s First Novel Rabies Monoclonal Antibodies (mAbs) cocktail containing Docaravimab and
Miromavimab, providing dual protection against rabies.

][22]
[Saroglitazar Tablets]

#### Lipaglyn - Novel drug to treat diabetic dyslipidemia, a global, unmet healthcare need.

The first NCE from an Indian research pipeline to move from the lab to the market.

[Adalimumab]

#### [Exemptia - The world’s first biosimilar of Adalimumab, the largest selling therapy globally
#### for treating auto immune disorders.][23]

Provides a new lease of life to Indian patients of inflammatory arthritis, who did not have access
to this revolutionary therapy, so far.

[VaxiFlu-4]

#### Vaxiflu-4 - India’s 1st Tetravalent Inactivated Influenza vaccine.

The vaccine provides protection from the four influenza viruses- H1N1, H3N2, Type B (Brisbane) and
Type B (Phuket).

## State-of-the-art manufacturing capabilities.

[Manufacturing]

As one of the key players amongst the pharmaceutical manufacturing companies, the group has
manufacturing capabilities across the entire pharmaceutical value chain: including formulations,
APIs, vaccines, biosimilars, complex products (transdermals, topical etc.), animal health products
and wellness products. It has more than 30 manufacturing plants worldwide including India, Brazil
and USA.

[View More][24]
